retrievalProfile.description: A mid-century music album layout featuring a candid studio portrait of two male vocalists in matching striped blazers with a top-aligned condensed sans-serif title bar.
excludeWhen: modern digital clean aesthetics are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring two men in a recording studio setting. One man faces forward while the other is in profile, both wearing matching thin-striped seersucker blazers over bright orange shirts. The background is a dark, textured studio wall. A vintage silver microphone is in the foreground. A heavy, condensed sans-serif title spans the top edge, utilizing color blocking to separate phrases.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject interaction between forward-facing and profile views
High-contrast color pop of orange shirts against neutral stripes and dark background
Top-heavy typographic header balancing the bottom-heavy subjects
Textural contrast between the smooth skin, striped fabric, and grainy background
coreInvariants: Condensed sans-serif display type at the top margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male subjects occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to mid-torso up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The forward-facing subject's face and the bright orange shirt collar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top text, moves down to the forward-facing singer, then follows his gaze/posture to the profile singer on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subjects and text fill most of the frame, with dark negative space only in the upper-middle background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral greys and blacks (background and blazers)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright orange (shirts and small logo block)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white stripes and dark background; high saturation only in the orange elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with color-based hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Small rectangular logo badge in bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Clean, condensed, and impactful for headers

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square photo of two men from the 1960s in a recording studio. One man faces the camera, the other is in profile. They wear matching thin-striped seersucker blazers and bright orange shirts. A vintage silver microphone is in the foreground. The background is dark and textured. Leave a clear horizontal band at the very top for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of extra-condensed, bold, uppercase sans-serif text across the top margin. Use pale yellow for the first three words and white for the remaining words. Add a small red square logo with a yellow crescent in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the text extra-condensed and uppercase?
Is the color palette dominated by orange, grey, and black?

adjustableVariables: Specific color of the first text block
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not overlap the subjects' heads.
Ensure the orange shirts are the most saturated element.
Verify the seersucker texture is visible.
Confirm the top text is flush with the top edge.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a candid duo portrait + apply a dark textured background + add a full-width condensed sans-serif header with dual-color coding.
